units.english: Clothing donations to <planet>
units.raw: name "Clothing donations to <planet>"

units.english: The fine citizens of <origin> seek a compassionate captain for a mission of mercy to donate <cargo> to the under-dressed and fashion-deprived souls of <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
units.raw: description "The fine citizens of <origin> seek a compassionate captain for a mission of mercy to donate <cargo> to the under-dressed and fashion-deprived souls of <destination>. Payment is <payment>."

units.english: You collect your payment of <payment>, but not before noticing the fine quality of the clothes worn by the dockworkers unloading the donation of <commodity>.
units.raw: dialog "You collect your payment of <payment>, but not before noticing the fine quality of the clothes worn by the dockworkers unloading the donation of <commodity>."

units.english: Medical aid to <planet>
units.raw: name "Medical aid to <planet>"

units.english: The fine citizens of <origin> seek a compassionate captain for a mission of mercy to donate <cargo> to the suffering souls of <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
units.raw: description "The fine citizens of <origin> seek a compassionate captain for a mission of mercy to donate <cargo> to the suffering souls of <destination>. Payment is <payment>."

units.english: You collect your payment of <payment>, but not before noticing the general health and vigor of the dockworkers unloading the donation of <commodity>.
units.raw: dialog "You collect your payment of <payment>, but not before noticing the general health and vigor of the dockworkers unloading the donation of <commodity>."

units.english: Charity goods to <planet>
units.raw: name "Charity goods to <planet>"

units.english: The fine citizens of <origin> seek a compassionate captain for a mission of mercy to donate <cargo> to the naive and culturally-underexposed souls of <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
units.raw: description "The fine citizens of <origin> seek a compassionate captain for a mission of mercy to donate <cargo> to the naive and culturally-underexposed souls of <destination>. Payment is <payment>."

units.english: You collect your payment of <payment>, but not before noticing the quality of the clothes, jewelry, and personal electronics carried by the dockworkers unloading the donation of <commodity>.
units.raw: dialog "You collect your payment of <payment>, but not before noticing the quality of the clothes, jewelry, and personal electronics carried by the dockworkers unloading the donation of <commodity>."

units.english: Party goods from <planet stopovers>
units.raw: name "Party goods from <planet stopovers>"

units.english: Planetside supplies of <commodity> are running low in the wake of an important gala. Pick up <tons> of it on <stopovers> and return to <origin> by <date>. Payment is <payment>.
units.raw: description "Planetside supplies of <commodity> are running low in the wake of an important gala. Pick up <tons> of it on <stopovers> and return to <origin> by <date>. Payment is <payment>."

units.english: You oversee the loading as dockworkers carry box after box of <commodity> onto your ship. Must be some party.
units.raw: dialog "You oversee the loading as dockworkers carry box after box of <commodity> onto your ship. Must be some party."

units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but forgot to pick up the <commodity> on <stopovers> first! Better head there before it's too late.
units.raw: dialog "You've returned to <planet>, but forgot to pick up the <commodity> on <stopovers> first! Better head there before it's too late."

units.english: Your ship is directed to land on a makeshift tarmac near a sprawling greenfield where novelty castles are being constructed. Sharply-dressed stewards unload the <commodity> and you collect your payment of <payment>.
units.raw: dialog "Your ship is directed to land on a makeshift tarmac near a sprawling greenfield where novelty castles are being constructed. Sharply-dressed stewards unload the <commodity> and you collect your payment of <payment>."

units.english: Estate assets to <planet>
units.raw: name "Estate assets to <planet>"

units.english: Trustees are seeking starship captains willing to deliver individual portions of a recently deceased upstanding citizen's estate - <cargo> - to the upcoming estate sale on <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
units.raw: description "Trustees are seeking starship captains willing to deliver individual portions of a recently deceased upstanding citizen's estate - <cargo> - to the upcoming estate sale on <destination>. Payment is <payment>."

units.english: As you watch the dockworkers unload crate after crate, you can't help but wonder what would drive someone to collect such a huge quantity of <commodity>. You collect your payment of <payment>.
units.raw: dialog "As you watch the dockworkers unload crate after crate, you can't help but wonder what would drive someone to collect such a huge quantity of <commodity>. You collect your payment of <payment>."

units.english: Contract laborers from <planet stopovers>
units.raw: name "Contract laborers from <planet stopovers>"

units.english: Return to <destination> after picking up <bunks> contract laborers located on <stopovers> who are eager to experience the luxury of the Paradise Worlds. Payment is <payment>.
units.raw: description "Return to <destination> after picking up <bunks> contract laborers located on <stopovers> who are eager to experience the luxury of the Paradise Worlds. Payment is <payment>."

units.english: The shabbily-dressed young men and women in the group don't look nearly as happy to be boarding your ship as you expected, given the new opportunity that awaits them. They shuffle wearily up the ramp for the return trip to <planet>.
units.raw: dialog "The shabbily-dressed young men and women in the group don't look nearly as happy to be boarding your ship as you expected, given the new opportunity that awaits them. They shuffle wearily up the ramp for the return trip to <planet>."

units.english: The bedraggled contract laborers kept to themselves and didn't say a word to you throughout the entire trip. The scruffy foreman who receives you on <origin> seems pleased, however. He hands you your payment of <payment>.
units.raw: dialog "The bedraggled contract laborers kept to themselves and didn't say a word to you throughout the entire trip. The scruffy foreman who receives you on <origin> seems pleased, however. He hands you your payment of <payment>."

units.english: Waste disposal on <planet>
units.raw: name "Waste disposal on <planet>"

units.english: Urgent waste disposal is needed. Transport <cargo> to <destination> to keep property values from falling. Payment is <payment>.
units.raw: description "Urgent waste disposal is needed. Transport <cargo> to <destination> to keep property values from falling. Payment is <payment>."

units.english: You drop off the exceptionally foul shipment of <commodity> on <planet>, already looking forward to the chemical bath your cargo hold is going to receive. You collect your payment of <payment> and hope that somebody around here knows what to do with the unpleasant mess you dropped off.
units.raw: dialog "You drop off the exceptionally foul shipment of <commodity> on <planet>, already looking forward to the chemical bath your cargo hold is going to receive. You collect your payment of <payment> and hope that somebody around here knows what to do with the unpleasant mess you dropped off."
